title: Isles
description: Isles adds team Skyblock islands, generator upgrades, PvP resource asteroids, and custom Nether/End progression for SMP servers.
body:
# Isles

Isles is a custom Skyblock plugin built for SMP-style servers that want more than isolated starter islands. It adds personal and team islands, protected void worlds, island spawn management, generator upgrades, and shared progression areas that give players reasons to explore, fight, and cooperate.

## Features

- Personal Skyblock islands with automatic creation
- Team islands with invites, shared ownership, renaming, kicking, leaving, and disbanding
- Protected island cores and safer void death handling
- Custom cobblestone generator upgrades
- A shared center asteroid field with regenerating resource nodes
- Center Shards, crates, and timed resource events
- PvP limited to intended hotspot areas
- Custom Nether archipelago progression with rare resources and protected terrain
- Shared End progression with a dragon arena
- Player-friendly commands for islands, upgrades, teams, and spawnpoints

Isles is designed for servers that want Skyblock to feel like a living world: private islands for building, shared zones for risk and reward, and long-term progression that brings players together.
